```{r download-link}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
zf <- targets::tar_read(latest_setup_zip)   # website/downloads/glm_aed_setup.zip, synced from OneDrive by the targets pipeline
cat(sprintf("**[Download the GLM-AED set-up (zip, %.0f MB)](downloads/glm_aed_setup.zip)**: namelists, AED files, all boundary files (meteorology, 13 inflows, outflow) and the calibrated parameters. Add the GLM-AED alum executable to run it.
", file.size(zf) / 1e6))
```

::: {.callout-note}
This page does **not** run the model. The baseline is run locally (`Rscript R/run_latest.R`, about 8 minutes) from the
`rotorua-pc10/latest/` folder on the team OneDrive, which holds the calibrated GLM-AED set-up, the parameters, the
executable and the observations. That run writes its full output as parquet into `latest/output/`, and this page
syncs and plots it. The baseline has no scenarios, and the run-info table below says exactly what produced the output.
:::

```{r setup}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(arrow); library(data.table)
library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

# where the "latest" folder lives locally: a mirror of rotorua-pc10/latest on OneDrive (synced here when the OneDrive token is set)
latest <- here::here("onedrive_mirror", "rotorua-pc10", "latest")
data_source <- "local mirror (OneDrive not used)"
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("ONEDRIVE_TOKEN_ENCRYPTED"))) {
  source(here::here("R", "sync_aeme_onedrive.R"))
  data_source <- tryCatch({
    sync_onedrive_file("rotorua-pc10/latest/metadata.json", file.path(latest, "metadata.json"))   # only the small files: the page needs the output, not the set-up
    sync_onedrive_folder("rotorua-pc10/latest/output", file.path(latest, "output"))
    "OneDrive: rotorua-pc10/latest"
  }, error = function(e) paste0("local mirror (OneDrive sync failed: ", substr(conditionMessage(e), 1, 80), ")"))
}
out <- file.path(latest, "output"); stopifnot(dir.exists(file.path(out, "model")))
meta <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(latest, "metadata.json")); runi <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(out, "run_info.json"))

raw <- open_dataset(file.path(out, "model", "output_raw"))
getv <- function(v) raw |> filter(var_sim == v) |> select(date, depth, value) |> collect() |> mutate(date = as.Date(date), value = if (v == "LKE_lvlwtr") value + meta$bed_elevation_m else value)   # level is written as a depth
obs <- read_parquet(file.path(out, "observations.parquet")) |> mutate(date = as.Date(date))
sed <- read_parquet(file.path(out, "model", "sediment.parquet")) |> mutate(date = as.Date(date))   # (filtered to the output period below)
d0 <- min(getv("LKE_lvlwtr")$date); d1 <- max(getv("LKE_lvlwtr")$date); obs <- obs |> filter(date >= d0, date <= d1); sed <- sed |> filter(date >= d0)

col_obs <- "#1b3a4b"; col_sim <- "#d95f02"; col_band <- "#cfe3f1"
alum_start <- as.Date("2006-01-01")
shade <- annotate("rect", xmin = alum_start, xmax = d1 + 365, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = col_band, alpha = 0.4)
th <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# surface (top 5 m mean) and bottom (within 3 m of the bed) daily series from the depth-resolved output
surf_bot <- function(v) {
  x <- getv(v) |> group_by(date) |> mutate(zmax = max(depth)) |> ungroup()
  bind_rows(x |> filter(depth <= 5) |> group_by(date) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(where = "Surface (0-5 m)"),
            x |> filter(depth >= zmax - 3) |> group_by(date) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(where = "Bottom (lowest 3 m)"))
}
obs_sb <- function(v) {
  x <- obs |> filter(var_aeme == v, !is.na(depth))
  bind_rows(x |> filter(depth <= 5) |> group_by(date) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(where = "Surface (0-5 m)"),
            x |> filter(depth >= 17) |> group_by(date) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(where = "Bottom (lowest 3 m)"))
}
sb_plot <- function(v, ylab) {
  s <- surf_bot(v); o <- obs_sb(v)
  ggplot() + shade + geom_line(data = s, aes(date, value, colour = "Simulated"), linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(data = o, aes(date, value, colour = "Observed"), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ factor(where, c("Surface (0-5 m)", "Bottom (lowest 3 m)")), ncol = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = col_obs, Simulated = col_sim)) + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, colour = NULL) + th
}

# model vs observation pairs: simulated value at the observed date and the nearest simulated depth
pair <- function(v) {
  o <- obs |> filter(var_aeme == v); s <- getv(v)
  if (all(is.na(o$depth))) { s <- s |> group_by(date) |> summarise(sim = mean(value), .groups = "drop"); return(inner_join(o |> select(date, obs = value), s, by = "date")) }
  so <- as.data.table(s); setnames(so, "value", "sim"); setkey(so, date, depth); ot <- as.data.table(o |> filter(!is.na(depth)) |> select(date, depth, obs = value))
  ot[, sim := so[.(ot$date, ot$depth), sim, roll = "nearest"]]; ot[!is.na(sim)] |> as_tibble()
}
cal0 <- as.Date("2006-06-01"); cal1 <- as.Date("2018-06-30"); val1 <- as.Date("2022-06-30")
vars <- c(HYD_temp = "Water temperature (°C)", CHM_oxy = "Dissolved oxygen (g/m³)", LKE_lvlwtr = "Lake level (m)", NIT_tn = "Total nitrogen (g/m³)", PHS_tp = "Total phosphorus (g/m³)", PHY_tchla = "Chlorophyll-a (mg/m³)")
perf <- lapply(names(vars), function(v) { p <- pair(v)
  per <- list(`All years` = p, `Calibration 2006-06 to 2018-06` = p |> filter(date >= cal0, date <= cal1), `Held out 2018-07 to 2022-06` = p |> filter(date > cal1, date <= val1), `New years 2022-07 to 2025-12` = p |> filter(date > val1))
  bind_rows(lapply(names(per), function(k) { x <- per[[k]]; data.frame(Variable = vars[[v]], Period = k, n = nrow(x), RMSE = sqrt(mean((x$sim - x$obs)^2)), Bias = mean(x$sim - x$obs), r2 = if (nrow(x) > 2) cor(x$sim, x$obs)^2 else NA) })) }) |> bind_rows()
```

## Run info {#run-info}

```{r run-info-table}
#| echo: false
data.frame(
  Field = c("Data source", "Output period (after spin-up)", "Spin-up", "Parameter set", "Calibration / held out", "Forcing", "Executable", "Set-up exported", "Git commit at export", "Run (local)", "Run time", "Scenarios"),
  Value = c(data_source, paste(format(d0), "to", format(d1)), paste(meta$simulation$spin_up_days, "days (from", meta$simulation$start, ")"), meta$parameter_source,
            paste(meta$calibration_period, "/", meta$held_out_period), meta$forcing, paste(meta$executable[1:2], collapse = "; "),
            paste(meta$exported, "by", meta$exported_by), paste0(meta$git_commit, if (isTRUE(meta$git_dirty)) " (uncommitted changes)" else ""),
            paste(runi$run, "by", runi$run_by), paste(runi$minutes, "min"), meta$scenarios)
) |> kbl() |> kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

Observations are from the Bay of Plenty Regional Council monitoring programme and only start in the 1990s, so the 1977–1989
results are not constrained by data. Blue shading marks the alum-dosing period (from 2006).

## Water temperature {#temp}

```{r plot-temperature}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated (line) and observed (points) water temperature at the surface and bottom."
#| fig-height: 6
sb_plot("HYD_temp", "Temperature (°C)")
```

```{r plot-temperature-heat}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated water temperature, monthly mean by depth."
#| fig-height: 4
getv("HYD_temp") |> mutate(m = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-01")), z = 2 * floor(depth / 2) + 1) |> group_by(m, z) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(m, z, fill = value)) + geom_tile() + scale_y_reverse() + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "°C") + labs(x = NULL, y = "Depth (m)") + th + theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r plot-thermocline}

getv("HYD_thmcln") |> group_by(m = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-01"))) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(m, value)) + geom_line(colour = col_sim) + scale_y_reverse() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Thermocline depth (m)") + th
```

## Lake level {#level}

```{r plot-level}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated lake water level (line) and observed level (points)."
#| fig-height: 3.5
ggplot() + geom_line(data = getv("LKE_lvlwtr") |> group_by(date) |> summarise(value = mean(value)), aes(date, value, colour = "Simulated"), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = obs |> filter(var_aeme == "LKE_lvlwtr"), aes(date, value, colour = "Observed"), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = col_obs, Simulated = col_sim)) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Level (m a.s.l.)", colour = NULL) + th
```

## Nutrients and chlorophyll-a {#nutrients}

```{r plot-nutrients}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated (surface, 0-5 m) and observed total phosphorus, total nitrogen and chlorophyll-a."
#| fig-height: 8
nut <- c(PHS_tp = "Total phosphorus (g/m³)", NIT_tn = "Total nitrogen (g/m³)", PHY_tchla = "Chlorophyll-a (mg/m³)")
s <- bind_rows(lapply(names(nut), function(v) surf_bot(v) |> filter(grepl("Surface", where)) |> mutate(var = nut[[v]])))
o <- bind_rows(lapply(names(nut), function(v) obs_sb(v) |> filter(grepl("Surface", where)) |> mutate(var = nut[[v]])))
ggplot() + shade + geom_line(data = s, aes(date, value, colour = "Simulated"), linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(data = o, aes(date, value, colour = "Observed"), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ var, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = col_obs, Simulated = col_sim)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL) + th
```

## Phytoplankton groups {#phyto-groups}

```{r plot-phytos}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated surface (0-5 m) phytoplankton group chlorophyll-a, monthly mean."
#| fig-height: 4
grp <- c(PHY_cyano = "Cyanobacteria", PHY_green = "Green algae", PHY_diatom = "Diatoms")
bind_rows(lapply(names(grp), function(v) getv(v) |> filter(depth <= 5) |> group_by(m = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-01"))) |> summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(group = grp[[v]]))) |>
  ggplot(aes(m, value, fill = group)) + geom_area() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Cyanobacteria = "#1b9e77", `Green algae` = "#7fb069", Diatoms = "#a6761d")) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Chl-a (mg/m³)", fill = NULL) + th
```

## Sediment fluxes and alum {#sediment}

```{r plot-sediment}
#| fig-cap: "Simulated sediment fluxes by sediment zone (coloured lines) and the lake-wide series written by the model (black), annual means, in the units GLM-AED writes. Zone 5 has no values."
#| fig-height: 8
fl <- c(SDF_Fsed_frp_Z = "Sediment P release (FRP flux)", SDF_Fsed_oxy_Z = "Sediment oxygen demand", ALU_bur_alp_Z = "Alum-bound P buried", ALU_res_alp_Z = "Alum-bound P released")
z <- sed |> filter(var_sim %in% names(fl), !is.na(zone)) |> group_by(var_sim, zone, yr = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |> summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(what = fl[var_sim], zone = factor(zone))
l <- sed |> filter(var_sim %in% paste0(names(fl), "_lake")) |> group_by(var_sim, yr = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |> summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(what = fl[sub("_lake$", "", var_sim)])
ggplot() + geom_line(data = z, aes(yr, value, colour = zone), linewidth = 0.5) + geom_line(data = l, aes(yr, value), colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ what, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Sediment zone") + th
```

In this configuration the sediment phosphorus release and oxygen demand are fixed rates per sediment zone (set in `aed.nml`),
so they do not respond to oxygen or alum. The alum terms are zero before dosing starts.

## Model performance summary {#performance}

```{r performance-stats}
#| echo: false
perf |>
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(duplicated(Variable), "", Variable)) |>
  kbl(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2), col.names = c("Variable", "Period", "n", "RMSE", "Bias (sim - obs)", "r²"),
      caption = "Model performance against observations (simulated value at the observed date and nearest depth). RMSE and bias in the units of the variable.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```
